## Critical rules (follow these BEFORE any action)
- DO NOT let public engine code (`engine/`) include Flashback or Wish private/product types; keep native backend types behind private implementation boundaries.
- DO NOT create task files, issue mirrors or status dashboards in `docs/`; GitHub Issues is the only source of truth for work state.
- DO NOT guess when info is missing — say NOT_FOUND and ask.
- DO NOT edit auto-generated files or build output (`build/`, `assets/compiled/`, `logs/`).
- DO NOT skip tests — every code change must include tests.
- DO NOT treat a green `debug-headless` run as proof that rendering code compiles: `engine/render`, `engine/platform`, `engine/ui`, `engine/input`, `engine/audio`, `client/` and `tools/` are only built when `AHAMKARA_BUILD_CLIENT=ON`. Build the `debug` preset (or compile the touched render files directly) for render changes.
- DO NOT claim validation you did not run; list the exact commands in your report.

## Build presets

| Preset | Builds | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| `debug-headless` | engine core/runtime/network/collision/physics/animation, game, Wish, server, tests | CMake >= 3.20, Ninja, C++20 compiler |
| `debug` / `release` | Everything above plus platform, render, ui, input, audio, client, tools, samples | Also OpenGL and GLFW3 (`libglfw3-dev` on Ubuntu) |
| `wish-standalone` | Engine core + Wish only | Same as headless |

Third-party libraries (glm, entt, miniaudio, Jolt, Lua, sol2) are fetched by CMake `FetchContent` at configure time, so the first configure needs network access.

## Agent quality gate

- Configure before C++ analysis: `cmake --preset debug`.
- Lint the complete branch diff: `./scripts/lint.sh --base-ref origin/main --compile-db build/debug`.
- Apply safe formatter fixes: `./scripts/lint.sh --base-ref origin/main --compile-db build/debug --fix`.
- Run the headless validation suite: `cmake --preset debug-headless && cmake --build --preset debug-headless && ctest --test-dir build/debug-headless --output-on-failure`.
- Read `build/lint/summary.md` first; machine-readable results are in `build/lint/summary.json` and the per-tool reports beside it.
- Do not broaden lint exclusions or weaken checks to make a ticket pass. Record genuine legacy debt in a specific GitHub issue.
